CUSTOMER.name: booking_details
CUSTOMER.title: Booking details
CUSTOMER.description: Details of one booking by its reference: status, dates, hotel or flight, price, PNR or hotel confirmation number, cancellation and refunds.

reference.description: Booking reference, e.g. HT-7K3M9Q2X or FL-4KD8M2PQ

CUSTOMER.name: cancellation_quote
CUSTOMER.title: Cancellation quote
CUSTOMER.description: What cancelling a booking would cost now: fee and refund amount, deadlines and policy. Read only: it never cancels.

reference.description: Booking reference, e.g. HT-7K3M9Q2X or FL-4KD8M2PQ

CUSTOMER.name: current_offers
CUSTOMER.title: Current offers
CUSTOMER.description: Active offers and their coupon codes.

CUSTOMER.name: hotel_details
CUSTOMER.title: Hotel details
CUSTOMER.description: Description, amenities, check-in and check-out times, policies and room types of one hotel, by its slug from search_hotels.

hotel.description: Hotel slug from search_hotels, e.g. sea-breeze-resort-goa

CUSTOMER.name: my_bookings
CUSTOMER.title: Your trips
CUSTOMER.description: List the signed-in customer's bookings (hotel stays and flights), newest first. tab UPCOMING = confirmed trips still ahead.

CUSTOMER.name: my_notifications
CUSTOMER.title: Your notifications
CUSTOMER.description: The signed-in user's notifications (bell), newest first, and how many are unread.

CUSTOMER.name: my_payments
CUSTOMER.title: Your payments
CUSTOMER.description: The signed-in customer's payment history, newest first: booking, amount, refunded amount, status, method, invoice number.

CUSTOMER.name: my_support_tickets
CUSTOMER.title: Your support tickets
CUSTOMER.description: The signed-in customer's support tickets, latest activity first.

CUSTOMER.name: my_trip_summary
CUSTOMER.title: Your travel summary
CUSTOMER.description: Totals for the signed-in customer: hotel and flight bookings, upcoming, completed and cancelled trips, money paid and refunded in a period, and the next trip.

range.description: Period of the totals (default LAST_12_MONTHS; ALL_TIME = since the first booking)

CUSTOMER.name: search_flights
CUSTOMER.title: Flight search
CUSTOMER.description: Find flights between two airports on a date (cheapest 5). origin and destination may be IATA codes (DEL, BOM) or city names.

origin.description: From: IATA code or city, e.g. DEL or Delhi

destination.description: To: IATA code or city, e.g. GOI or Goa

returnDate.description: Return date YYYY-MM-DD for a round trip

CUSTOMER.name: search_hotels
CUSTOMER.title: Hotel search
CUSTOMER.description: Find available hotels in a city for given dates, cheapest or best first (top 5).

destination.description: City or hotel name, e.g. Goa

maxPricePerNight.description: Highest price per night in rupees

ADMIN.name: admin_dashboard
ADMIN.title: Admin dashboard
ADMIN.description: Business figures for a period: paid bookings (hotel, flight), customers, payments, revenue, refunds, top destinations and hotels.

range.description: Period (default LAST_30_DAYS). LAST_7_DAYS = today and the 6 days before. CUSTOM needs from and to.

ADMIN.name: booking_details
ADMIN.title: Booking details
ADMIN.description: Details of one booking by its reference: status, dates, hotel or flight, price, PNR or hotel confirmation number, cancellation and refunds.

reference.description: Booking reference, e.g. HT-7K3M9Q2X or FL-4KD8M2PQ

ADMIN.name: cancellation_quote
ADMIN.title: Cancellation quote
ADMIN.description: What cancelling a booking would cost now: fee and refund amount, deadlines and policy. Read only: it never cancels.

reference.description: Booking reference, e.g. HT-7K3M9Q2X or FL-4KD8M2PQ

ADMIN.name: run_report
ADMIN.title: Report
ADMIN.description: An admin report for a period with totals over all rows: bookings, revenue, payments, refunds, cancellations, destinations or customers.

range.description: Period (default LAST_30_DAYS). LAST_7_DAYS = today and the 6 days before. CUSTOM needs from and to.

status.description: Status filter: bookings = booking status; payments = SUCCESS or FAILED; refunds = REQUESTED, COMPLETED or FAILED

ADMIN.name: search_bookings
ADMIN.title: Booking search
ADMIN.description: Search all bookings by reference, customer e-mail, PNR or hotel confirmation number, status, type and creation date. Returns the count and the newest rows.

q.description: Reference, e-mail, PNR or confirmation number (exact)

ADMIN.name: search_payments
ADMIN.title: Payment search
ADMIN.description: Search payment attempts by booking reference or payment id, status (SUCCESS, FAILED, ...) and date. Returns the count and the newest rows.

ADMIN.name: search_refunds
ADMIN.title: Refund search
ADMIN.description: Search refunds by booking reference, status (PENDING, PROCESSED, FAILED) and date.

HOTEL_MANAGER.name: hotel_arrivals_departures
HOTEL_MANAGER.title: Arrivals and departures
HOTEL_MANAGER.description: Guests arriving (check-in) or leaving (check-out) on a day (default today) at your hotels. kind ARRIVALS for who is arriving, DEPARTURES for who is leaving.

hotel.description: Hotel name (or part of it); leave out for all your hotels

HOTEL_MANAGER.name: hotel_dashboard
HOTEL_MANAGER.title: Hotel dashboard
HOTEL_MANAGER.description: Today's arrivals, departures, in-house guests and occupancy, plus reservations, room nights, revenue, ADR and cancellations for a period.

hotel.description: Hotel name (or part of it); leave out for all your hotels

range.description: Period (default LAST_30_DAYS). LAST_7_DAYS = today and the 6 days before. CUSTOM needs from and to.

HOTEL_MANAGER.name: hotel_occupancy
HOTEL_MANAGER.title: Occupancy and revenue
HOTEL_MANAGER.description: Occupancy % (booked / available room nights), room revenue and ADR of your hotels for a period.

hotel.description: Hotel name (or part of it); leave out for all your hotels

range.description: Period (default LAST_30_DAYS). LAST_7_DAYS = today and the 6 days before. CUSTOM needs from and to.

HOTEL_MANAGER.name: hotel_reservations
HOTEL_MANAGER.title: Hotel reservations
HOTEL_MANAGER.description: Search reservations of your hotels by status, check-in dates or guest name / booking reference / confirmation number.

hotel.description: Hotel name (or part of it); leave out for all your hotels

q.description: Guest name, booking reference or confirmation number

HOTEL_MANAGER.name: my_hotels
HOTEL_MANAGER.title: Your hotels
HOTEL_MANAGER.description: Names of the hotels assigned to you. Not needed before the other hotel tools: without a hotel name they cover all your hotels.

SUPPORT_AGENT.name: find_bookings
SUPPORT_AGENT.title: Booking lookup

SUPPORT_AGENT.name: ticket_metrics
SUPPORT_AGENT.title: Support metrics
SUPPORT_AGENT.description: Support figures for a period: tickets opened and resolved, open tickets by age, first response and resolution times.

range.description: Period (default LAST_30_DAYS). LAST_7_DAYS = today and the 6 days before. CUSTOM needs from and to.

SUPPORT_AGENT.name: ticket_queue
SUPPORT_AGENT.title: Ticket queue
SUPPORT_AGENT.description: Support tickets by status, assignment and priority, oldest last message first.

q.description: Ticket number, customer e-mail or words of the subject

SUPPORT_AGENT.name: ticket_summary
SUPPORT_AGENT.title: Ticket summary
SUPPORT_AGENT.description: How many tickets are open, in progress, waiting for the customer, escalated, unassigned and assigned to me.
